blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over 1.4 million passengers have passed through the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) during the Undas week, the terminal said on Monday. PITX recorded a total of 1,499,454 passengers from Oct. 25 to Nov. 1. The termina is anticipating another 180,000 passengers on All Souls’ Day, as the Undas winds down. As of 10 am, PITX recorded 55,317 passengers, a several thousand fewer than the figures reported during the same period in the past few days.
